# downloader.resilience.make_store { #spotforecast2_safe.downloader.resilience.make_store }

```python
downloader.resilience.make_store()
```

Build a ``SnapshotStore`` rooted at ``<data_home>/snapshots/``.

Lazy so that ``configure_environment()`` runs before ``get_data_home()``
is called. Public: ``chronos.py`` builds its combined-DE-total fallback
on the same store, so the snapshot root and TTL conventions stay defined
once, here.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name          | Type              | Description                                                        |
|---------------|-------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| SnapshotStore | \'SnapshotStore\' | A TTL-aware atomic snapshot store rooted at                        |
|               | \'SnapshotStore\' | ``<data_home>/snapshots`` with a time-to-live of ``SNAPSHOT_TTL``. |
